metadata.name: DateTime Tools
metadata.description: Tools for getting current date and time information

tools.name: get_current_time
tools.description: Get the current wall clock time

examples.query: Tell me the current time in human format

usage_hints: Use when user asks about current time
Use when user asks 'what time is it'
Use when user asks 'what's the time'

tools.name: get_current_date
usage_hints: Use when user asks about current date
Use when user asks 'what day is it'
Use when user asks 'what's the date'

tools.name: get_datetime
tools.description: Get both current date and time together

returns.description: Current date and time in requested format

examples.query: What's the current date and time?

usage_hints: Use when user asks for both date and time
Use when user asks 'what time and date is it'
